parameters: (Alicia appears to have been wounded recently, past the point where she would be of any use in a fight of any kind.)
Derrick, I'm hurt really bad.  I can't fight.
I'll see what I can do for you.
Hi Derrick, have you seen my son Billy?  I'm not sure where he went.
I last saw him go upstairs to the cafeteria to eat something.  He looked like he was hurt really bad from battle.
Really bad.  He can't fight like that.  I'll see to it that he gets healed and back in shape, either onboard the ship or back in town somewhere.
Yes, please do that for him, thanks.
He was hanging out in the cafeteria upstairs, last time I checked.  Do you want me to go check on him?
Only if you want to.  I'm sure he's fine - I was just wondering, thanks.
